task: Find the ArXiv Blog on the ArXiv website and summarize the content of its latest article.
answer: The ArXiv Blog is located at https://blog.arxiv.org/ (linked from the arXiv About page). The latest article is 'Attention Authors: Temporary changes to announcement schedule due to upcoming US federal holiday' (November 6th 2026) at https://blog.arxiv.org/2026/11/06/announcement-change-veterans-day/. Summary: arXiv will observe Veterans Day on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, temporarily affecting mailings, the help desk, and the announcement schedule while staff are offline. Only announcements of new submissions are affected; servers remain operational, existing papers stay browsable, and new submissions are still accepted. Articles received and accepted at or after 14:00 ET Tuesday, November 10, and before 14:00 ET Thursday, November 12, will be announced on Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 20:00 ET. The post also warns that upcoming US federal holidays (Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year's Eve) will further affect announcement schedules, and encourages users to subscribe to the blog or follow arXiv on social media for updates.
